title: UK Police Mock Car Chase Criminal for Missing GTA6 Launch
description: Derbyshire Police in the UK went viral on TikTok by mocking a car chase criminal, pointing out that their arrest means missing out on the highly anticipated GTA 6 launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## UK Police Troll Car Chase Suspect Over Missing GTA 6 Launch

As the gaming community eagerly counts down to the arrival of Rockstar Games' next blockbuster, the anticipation surrounding the title continues to permeate pop culture in unexpected ways. Recently, law enforcement in the UK found a uniquely humorous way to address local crime, going viral by pointing out a criminal's worst collateral damage: missing out on the launch of *Grand Theft Auto 6*.

### A High-Speed Chase and a Pop Culture Punishment

According to reports from IGN Games, police officers in Derbyshire, England, recently engaged in a high-stakes high-speed car chase with a suspect who attempted to evade the law. The dangerous pursuit ultimately concluded with the suspect successfully apprehended and taken into custody.

However, it was the aftermath on social media that caught the attention of the gaming world. Derbyshire Police took to TikTok to share a video mocking the suspect's poor decision-making. In the viral post, officers highlighted a particularly painful consequence of the criminal's actions: because of their arrest, they are now going to miss out on the highly-anticipated launch of *GTA 6*.

The clever integration of gaming culture into law enforcement public relations quickly gained traction online, racking up views and comments from amused netizens who appreciated the playful jab.

### The Cultural Footprint of a Blockbuster

Incidents like this highlight just how massive the cultural footprint of *GTA 6* has become ahead of its release. The game is not merely an upcoming entertainment product; it has firmly established itself as a global touchstone referenced by everything from mainstream media to local police departments.

While law-abiding fans around the world prepare to dive into the open-world experience on day one, this particular individual will be experiencing the historic gaming milestone from a very different perspective. It serves as an entertaining reminder that crime doesn't pay—and sometimes, it costs you the biggest game of the decade.

### Editor's Take

Derbyshire Police's TikTok stunt is a brilliant example of modern digital policing meeting internet culture. While high-speed chases are a serious matter, using the massive cultural weight of *GTA 6* to deliver a humorous reality check is both clever and uniquely entertaining.
